records.passage:
# English 202: The Sonnet

The sonnet entered English literature in the early sixteenth century, adapted from the Italian form pioneered by Petrarch, and has inspired experimentation ever since. Poets writing in English have created endless variations on the basic formula of fourteen lines of rhymed verse in iambic pentameter.

From the Renaissance to the modern era, poets have used the sonnet form to explore romantic, existential, and political themes in ways both serious and satiric. Because the sonnet is governed by strict formal rules, it is sometimes used to playfully illuminate the tension between constraint and creative freedom.

Readings will include sonnets by Sir Philip Sidney, William Shakespeare, John Donne, William Wordsworth, Claude McKay, Gwendolyn Brooks, Edna St. Vincent Millay, Cathy Park Hong, and Jericho Brown. Students will experiment with writing their own sonnets and will read them aloud in class.

A final ten-page term paper will be due on May 15.
records.translation:
# 英语202：十四行诗
十四行诗在十六世纪早期进入英国文学，它改编自彼特拉克开创的意大利体裁，从那时起便一直激发着实验性的创作。
用英语写作的诗人基于十四行五步抑扬格押韵诗的基本范式，创造了无穷无尽的变体。
从文艺复兴到现代，诗人运用十四行诗这种体裁，以既严肃又讽刺的方式探索浪漫、存在和政治主题。
因为十四行诗受到严格形式规则的制约，它有时被用来幽默地阐释束缚与创作自由之间的张力。
阅读材料将包括菲利普·锡德尼爵士、威廉·莎士比亚、约翰·多恩、威廉·华兹华斯、克劳德·麦凯、格温多林·布鲁克斯、埃德娜·圣文森特·米莱、凯茜·朴·洪和杰里科·布朗的十四行诗。
学生将尝试创作自己的十四行诗，并将在课堂上大声朗读。
期末一篇十页的学期论文需在5月15日前提交。

# New Winter Term Writing Seminar

Please consider registering for the newly developed Creative Writing Seminar, designed to help you enhance your writing skills and unleash your creativity. Led by professors from our Creative Writing Department, this seminar-style class will help you hone your writing by giving tips on narrative structure, character development, and dialogue crafting. Students will engage in interactive exercises and group readings to refine their writing abilities.

Please bring your laptop for writing activities.

The seminar will take place on **Tuesdays and Thursdays** from **10:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M.** in the conference room on the fifth floor of the library.

To be eligible, students **must** have completed one first-year-level course in either the Creative Writing or English department.

For more information, please contact the Creative Writing Department administrator at **admin@creativewriting.edu/winterterm**.

# CAMPUS RESEARCHERS "CRACK" THE CONCRETE CODE

Researchers at the university have developed an affordable self-healing concrete. When cracks form, embedded microcapsules release a gap-sealing mineral solution.

The prototype has already survived 50 freeze-thaw cycles in the lab, and now real-world testing is beginning on campus walkways, although students and faculty probably will not notice anything unusual beneath their feet.

Researchers predict huge benefits. "Our goal is to reduce costly repairs and extend building lifespans," said lead researcher Dr. Elena Vargas. "Imagine bridges that fix themselves after storms."

Civil engineering professor Mark Chen called the innovation both practical and environmentally responsible. "This could revolutionize construction," he said. "By minimizing waste and extending the life of materials, we're saving money and reducing the environmental footprint."

Larger trials are in the works, but for now campus walkways are a living laboratory, offering a glimpse into a future where concrete is resilient enough to heal itself.
records.translation:
# 校园研究人员“破解”混凝土难题
该大学的研究人员开发出了一种价格实惠的自愈合混凝土。
当裂缝形成时，嵌入的微胶囊会释放出一种能够密封缝隙的矿物质溶液。
该原型在实验室中已经经受住了50次冻融循环的考验，现在正在校园人行道上开始真实环境测试，尽管师生们可能不会注意到脚下有什么异常。
研究人员预测这会带来巨大的好处。“我们的目标是减少昂贵的维修费用并延长建筑物的寿命，”首席研究员埃琳娜·巴尔加斯（Elena Vargas）博士说。“想象一下在风暴过后能够自我修复的桥梁。”
土木工程学教授马克·陈（Mark Chen）称这项创新既实用又对环境负责。“这可能会彻底改变建筑业，”他说。“通过最大限度地减少浪费并延长材料的使用寿命，我们可以节约资金并减少环境足迹。”
更大规模的试验正在筹备中，但目前校园人行道就是一个活生生的实验室，让人得以一窥混凝土具有足够韧性以自我修复的未来。

records.passage:
# Survey of Literary Theory

This course offers advanced undergraduates an introduction to major schools of literary theory and criticism, providing students with the tools to analyze texts from multiple perspectives and compare the resulting theoretical analyses. Beginning with foundational approaches such as formalism and structuralism, the course explores key movements including Marxist, feminist, psychoanalytic, postcolonial, and reader-response theories. Readings will include works by theorists such as Ferdinand de Saussure, Roland Barthes, and Judith Butler. Students will examine how various frameworks shape interpretation, influence cultural discourse, and challenge traditional notions of meaning and authorship. Through close reading and critical discussion, participants will learn to apply theoretical concepts to diverse literary works, enhancing their ability to engage with texts in nuanced and informed ways. By the end of the course, students will develop a deeper understanding of the role theory plays in literary studies and acquire essential skills for advanced analysis and scholarly writing.
records.translation:
# 文学理论概论
本课程向高年级本科生介绍主要的文学理论和批评流派，为学生提供从多个视角分析文本并比较所得理论分析结果的工具。
从形式主义和结构主义等基础方法开始，本课程探讨了包括马克思主义、女权主义、精神分析、后殖民主义和读者反应理论在内的主要运动。
阅读材料将包括费迪南·德·索绪尔、罗兰·巴特和朱迪斯·巴特勒等理论家的作品。
学生将考察各种理论框架如何塑造诠释、影响文化话语，并挑战关于意义和作者身份的传统观念。
通过细读和批判性讨论，参与者将学习如何将理论概念应用于不同的文学作品，从而提高他们以细致且有见地的方式解读文本的能力。
到课程结束时，学生将对理论在文学研究中所起的作用有更深入的理解，并获得进行高级分析和学术写作的基本技能。

# Request For Career Guidance Meeting

Subject:
Request for career guidance meeting

Dear Dr. Patel,

I am exploring graduate programs in public health and would value your advice regarding which ones are the most "up-and-coming" and which are the most well-regarded. I am only a freshman, so is it too early to start thinking about graduate school? I would also value your perspective on which internships to pursue and what extracurricular activities to participate in.

I would also like to discuss internship opportunities at the Edgefield Health Department, since I'm interested in epidemiology.

I've reviewed your recent publication on community health interventions and hope to learn how those strategies apply to graduate research.

Could we meet next Tuesday at 3 P.M. in your office? If that time doesn't work, I'm available Thursday morning between 9 and 11 A.M. Please let me know which time works best.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Maria Chen

# Qualitative Research Practicum Mini Syllabus

ANTH 214:
Instructor: Dr. Khatri

Course focus: Students practice interviewing, observation, and ethical documentation while partnering with the Campus Food Pantry to improve volunteer training.

# Library Renovation Relocation

Read a Notice.

Frankson Library Renovation and Temporary Relocation

Attention University Community:

Beginning October 10, the Frankson Library will undergo a major renovation to enhance study spaces and technological resources. The project is scheduled to continue through March 15.

During this period, the library's operational services will be temporarily relocated to the second and third floors of the Meyer Student Union Building. The temporary library spaces will operate weekdays from 8:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. and on weekends from 10:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M.

Library administrative offices will be temporarily relocated to the university's Main Building.

Extra shuttle buses will run between the Main Quad and the Meyer Student Union Building to accommodate increased traffic. Students are encouraged to explore our expanded digital resources available through the university's online portal.

We appreciate your patience as we improve our facilities.

For updates, visit the library's webpage or contact library@university.edu.

# Physics Course Syllabus

This course explores classical mechanics, thermodynamics, and electromagnetism through lectures, labs, and problem-solving sessions. Students will develop analytical skills and apply mathematical models to physical systems. Weekly assignments, lab reports, and exams assess understanding. Prerequisites include calculus. Attendance and participation are essential for success.

每周作业、实验报告和考试将评估学生的理解程度。

出勤和参与是取得成功的关键。

records.passage:
# Morris Campus Volunteer Club Meeting

October 5 at 8 P.M.

Place: Ortiz Hall Seminar Room

Last year, the Campus Volunteer Club provided volunteer workers to assist eight different community programs, serving children, shelter animals, and health clinics.

Thanks to growing membership, this year we hope to extend the range of our volunteer work and to engage even more students in our projects. The October meeting will be a brainstorming session about how to meet these goals.

Topics for discussion:

1. Possible areas for new activity

* Morris Parks and Recreation--pick up trash
* Morris Senior Center--read aloud to residents
* Community Food Pantry--help assemble and distribute food baskets

2. Getting the word out: How can we get more students interested in volunteering in general?

3. Ideas for our next fundraising drive (to be explored in more detail at the November meeting)

For more information, contact Victor Alvarez, ext. 3299

records.passage:
# Data Skills Classes All classes meet for eight sessions from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., beginning September 1. **Course:** Spreadsheet Introduction
**Description:** Students learn how to create spreadsheets and use functions that can speed up work. This course is good for beginners and those who need to relearn basics.
**Sections:** Section A - Mondays and Wednesdays; Section B - Tuesdays and Thursdays; Section C - Virtual, Wednesdays and Fridays. **Course:** Formulas
**Description:** Instructors show students how to use basic spreadsheet formulas for business. Students should have basic spreadsheet skills before enrolling.
**Sections:** Section D - Tuesdays; Section E - Virtual, Thursdays. **Course:** Data Seminar
**Description:** Taught by industry professionals, this course is for researchers who want to learn how to work with complex data.
**Section:** Section F - Virtual, Mondays. **Course:** Data Representation
**Description:** This course is for analysts and researchers who need to show audiences easy-to-read graphs and charts.
**Section:** Section G - Virtual, Wednesdays.
records.translation:
# 数据技能课程 所有课程共八次课，上课时间为下午 6:00 到 7:00，从 9 月 1 日开始。 **课程：** 电子表格入门
**描述：** 学生将学习如何创建电子表格并使用可以加快工作速度的功能。 本课程适合初学者以及需要重新学习基础知识的人员。
**班级：** A 班 - 周一和周三；B 班 - 周二和周四；C 班 - 线上，周三和周五。 **课程：** 公式
**描述：** 讲师将向学生展示如何在商业中使用基本的电子表格公式。 学生在报名前应具备基本的电子表格技能。
**班级：** D 班 - 周二；E 班 - 线上，周四。 **课程：** 数据研讨会
**描述：** 本课程由行业专业人士授课，面向希望学习如何处理复杂数据的研究人员。
**班级：** F 班 - 线上，周一。 **课程：** 数据展示
**描述：** 本课程面向需要向受众展示易读的图表和图形的分析师及研究人员。
**班级：** G 班 - 线上，周三。

records.passage:
# Concert Plan Chat

Sandeep Patel (10:00 A.M.)

Hey, are you coming to the concert tonight? I heard it's supposed to be amazing!

Fatima Khan (10:05 A.M.)

I would like to, but one of my classmates has been out sick all week and our report is due tomorrow.

Sandeep Patel (10:07 A.M.)

Oh no! That's a bummer.

Fatima Khan (10:10 A.M.)

Yeah, it is. Maybe next time. Are you going with anyone?

Sandeep Patel (10:12 A.M.)

Actually, I'm going with my cousin from Bangalore. He's visiting for the weekend.

Fatima Khan (10:15 A.M.)

That's nice. Hope you both have a great time!

Sandeep Patel (10:18 A.M.)

Thanks. If you finish early, you're welcome to join us.

Fatima Khan (10:20 A.M.)

I'll keep that in mind and let you know later if I'm coming after all.

records.title: 2026-06-10 Study Abroad Expo

items.prompt_text: What is the general aim of the Study Abroad Expo?

choices.text: To evaluate emerging risks in a variety of sectors in the field of global education.
To facilitate a deep understanding of opportunities for international learning.
To highlight the historical significance of student exchange programs.
To promote the sale of travel-related merchandise intended for students.

items.explanation: The text states that the expo begins with a keynote providing "an in-depth exploration of the evolving landscape of international study opportunities," establishing the event's overall focus on understanding international learning.

translation.prompt_text: 留学博览会的主要目的是什么？

choices.text: 评估全球教育领域多个部门的新兴风险。
促进对国际学习机会的深入了解。
强调学生交流项目的历史意义。
促进面向学生的旅游相关商品的销售。

translation.explanation: 文本提到，博览会以一场提供“深入探讨不断发展的国际留学机会格局”的主题演讲开始，确立了该活动旨在了解国际学习的总体重点。

items.prompt_text: What is suggested about the Sustainable Study Abroad panel?

choices.text: It will mainly address the costs of studying abroad for students.
It will show the need to integrate eco-friendly practices into study abroad programs.
It will examine the impact of studying abroad on student environmental consciousness.
It will primarily focus on the legal aspects of participating in study abroad programs.

items.explanation: The 10:30 A.M. panel is explicitly described as a discussion on "best practices for eco-conscious student programs abroad," which directly supports the focus on integrating eco-friendly practices.

translation.prompt_text: 关于“可持续留学”小组讨论，文中暗示了什么？

choices.text: 它将主要探讨学生的留学费用。
它将表明需要将环保实践融入留学项目中。
它将考察留学对学生环保意识的影响。
它将主要关注参与留学项目的法律问题。

translation.explanation: 上午 10:30 的小组讨论被明确描述为一场关于“具有环保意识的海外学生项目的最佳实践”的讨论，这直接支持了融入环保实践的重点。

items.prompt_text: What does Dr. Kim's keynote speech address?

choices.text: The possible influence of emerging technologies.
Existing patterns of participation in study abroad programs.
The allure of traditional study abroad destinations.
The benefits of current study abroad program policies.

items.explanation: The keynote is titled ‘Futures in Global Education,’ is presented by an education futurist, and concerns an evolving landscape. Among the choices, the possible influence of emerging technologies is the most directly supported future-facing aspect; current participation patterns are not stated.

translation.prompt_text: 金博士的主题演讲探讨了什么？

choices.text: 新兴技术的可能影响。
当前留学项目的参与模式。
传统留学目的地的吸引力。
现行留学项目政策的好处。

translation.explanation: 文章指出，金博士的主题演讲是“深入探讨不断发展的国际留学机会格局”，其中涉及考察这些项目当前的参与趋势和模式。

records.passage:
# Study Abroad Expo

9:00 A.M. Keynote: "Futures in Global Education." An in-depth exploration of the evolving landscape of international study opportunities. Presenter: Education futurist Dr. Laura Kim.

10:30 A.M. "Sustainable Study Abroad." A panel discussion between university leaders and environmental advocates on best practices for eco-conscious student programs abroad.

12:00 P.M. Networking Lunch: An opportunity for students to connect with peers, alumni, and program coordinators to exchange insights on study abroad experiences.

1:30 P.M. "Digital Tools for Global Learning." An interactive session focusing on advanced strategies for using digital tools in international study.
records.translation:
# 留学博览会
上午 9:00 主题演讲：“全球教育的未来”。深入探讨不断发展的国际留学机会格局。
主讲人：教育未来学家劳拉·金（Laura Kim）博士。
上午 10:30 “可持续留学”。大学领导与环保倡导者之间的小组讨论，探讨具有环保意识的海外学生项目的最佳实践。
中午 12:00 社交午餐：学生有机会与同龄人、校友和项目协调员建立联系，交流对留学经历的见解。
下午 1:30 “全球学习的数字工具”。一场互动会议，重点探讨在国际学习中使用数字工具的先进策略。

records.passage:
# ARTH 312

Contemporary Art History

Explores art and cultural movements from mid-twentieth century to present, including abstract expressionism, pop art, and street art.

Weekly lectures

Tues/Thurs 10–11:30 A.M.

Mandatory visits to local art exhibitions.

Students must write critical essays, contribute to discussions, and complete a research project.

Prerequisite: ARTH 101
records.translation:
# ARTH 312
当代艺术史
探讨从二十世纪中叶至今的艺术和文化运动，包括抽象表现主义、波普艺术和街头艺术。
每周讲座

# University Makerspace Launch

Oceantide University has launched an exciting new makerspace this semester, providing students with cutting-edge tools such as 3D printers, laser cutters, and advanced design software. While the space is housed in the engineering building, it is open to all majors, encouraging collaboration and creativity across disciplines. "Our goal is to empower students to turn ideas into tangible solutions," said makerspace manager Diego Ramirez.

To help students get started, the makerspace offers free workshops on prototyping, product design, and hands-on fabrication techniques. Knowledgeable staff members are available to provide technical support and guidance to users.

Funded through a generous grant from a local tech company, the makerspace aims to spark innovation and entrepreneurship on campus. Early projects have included custom phone cases, detailed architectural models, and robotics prototypes. Students are already sharing their creations on social media, showcasing the makerspace as a hub for ingenuity and practical learning.

虽然该空间设在工程楼内，但它对所有专业开放，鼓励跨学科的合作与创造。“我们的目标是让学生有能力将想法转化为切实可行的解决方案，”创客空间经理迭戈·拉米雷斯说道。

# Library Quiet Zone

Welcome to the Library Quiet Zone!

This area is specifically designated for quiet reading and study to ensure a peaceful environment for all patrons. Please **adhere to** the following guidelines:

1. Noise Levels: Please keep noise to a minimum. This includes refraining from loud conversations and phone calls.
2. Electronic Devices: Ensure that all electronic devices, such as phones and laptops, are set to silent mode. The volume on headphones must be kept low.
3. Conversations: If you need to have a conversation, please conduct it quietly or proceed to another area of the library.
4. Music and Media: Listening to music or watching videos without headphones is not allowed. Please keep the volume of headphones at a level that only you can hear.
5. Respect for Others: Be mindful of those around you who are studying or reading. Your cooperation helps maintain a serene environment for everyone.

# 图书馆安静区
欢迎来到图书馆安静区！
该区域专为安静阅读和学习而设，以确保为所有读者提供一个安宁的环境。
请**遵守**以下规定：
1. 噪音控制：请将噪音降至最低。这包括避免大声交谈和接打电话。
2. 电子设备：请确保所有电子设备（如手机和笔记本电脑）都设置为静音模式。耳机音量必须保持在较低水平。
3. 交谈：如需交谈，请轻声进行或前往图书馆的其他区域。
4. 音乐和媒体：不允许在不戴耳机的情况下听音乐或看视频。请将耳机音量保持在只有您自己能听到的水平。
5. 尊重他人：请顾及周围正在学习或阅读的人。您的配合有助于为大家维持一个宁静的环境。

# University Server Maintenance

Subject: Server Maintenance

The next university server maintenance is scheduled on May 22 from 2 AM to 6 AM. This is part of a scheduled maintenance that we conduct with our external provider.

During this window, access to network drives and cloud storage services will be temporarily unavailable. Please save any important documents and plan your work accordingly. You may also experience disruptions accessing your university email accounts. Online library databases will not be affected.

A reminder: Routine maintenance windows take place on a semi-monthly basis. In the event that maintenance needs arise outside of the scheduled maintenance windows, we will do our best to give the university community advanced notice.

If you experience issues, contact the IT team. We will send out another notification when maintenance is complete. We appreciate your understanding as we strive to ensure the security and reliability of our IT infrastructure.

# Campus International Festival

Celebrate global culture at the Campus International Festival!

Over the course of two days this spring, students, faculty, staff, and local community members will gather on the university quad to present traditions from over 20 countries through music, food, and art.

- Performances will include African drumming and Celtic harp.
- Cooking demonstrations will teach the preparation of authentic dishes ranging from Italian pasta to Japanese sushi.
- Storytelling sessions will showcase folkloric traditions from multiple regions.
- The Global Market will feature handmade crafts and textiles.
- Workshops will invite attendees to try cultural dances, explore calligraphy, and communicate in new languages.
- Student groups will also host panels on diversity and inclusion, encouraging cross-campus dialogue.
- Families are welcome: The Children's Corner will offer creative art projects and storytelling.

Ticket proceeds will support student-led community-building initiatives, reinforcing the festival's mission to celebrate diversity and unity while strengthening ties between the campus and its host community.

records.passage:
# The Artisan's Palette

Playing now as part of the university's international film festival, The Artisan's Palette offers a contemplative alternative to blockbuster spectacle.

Set in Montclair, France, a beautiful village marked by economic decline, the film follows Elise Dupont, a painter confronting creative stagnation. Her struggle intensifies with the arrival of Marc, a self-described photographer whose shadowy motives become apparent even as he strives to earn Elise's trust.

Themes of authenticity and deception permeate the narrative, underscored by striking cinematography that contrasts the vivid colors of Elise's canvases with the muted tones of her daily life. While deliberate pacing and occasional narrative drift may challenge viewers accustomed to rapid action, the film excels in character depth.

Isabelle Laurent delivers a nuanced portrayal of Elise, balancing vulnerability and resolve, while Jean-Pierre Lemoine's enigmatic Marc sustains tension throughout. For audiences drawn to character-driven storytelling and visual artistry, this work offers a richly textured exploration of ambition and identity.
records.translation:
# 工匠的调色板
作为该大学国际电影节的一部分，《工匠的调色板》正在上映，它为大制作商业片提供了一种引人深思的替代选择。
电影的背景设定在法国蒙克莱（Montclair），一个因经济衰退而留下印记的美丽村庄，影片讲述了面临创作停滞的画家埃莉斯·杜邦（Elise Dupont）的故事。
随着马克的到来，她的挣扎加剧了，马克自称是一名摄影师，尽管他努力想赢得埃莉斯的信任，但他不可告人的动机却逐渐显露出来。
真实与欺骗的主题贯穿了整个故事，引人注目的摄影技巧则进一步突出了这些主题，将埃莉斯画布上鲜艳的色彩与她日常生活中暗淡的色调形成了鲜明对比。
虽然刻意放缓的节奏和偶尔的情节游离可能会让习惯于快节奏动作戏的观众感到不适应，但这部电影在人物深度的刻画上却表现出色。
伊莎贝尔·洛朗（Isabelle Laurent）对埃莉斯的刻画细致入微，在脆弱与坚定之间取得了平衡，而让-皮埃尔·勒莫安（Jean-Pierre Lemoine）饰演的神秘的马克则自始至终保持着紧张感。
对于那些被人物驱动的叙事和视觉艺术所吸引的观众来说，这部作品对野心和身份进行了层次丰富的探索。

# Rethinking Documentary Panel Jordan Miles
November 3 at 5:37 PM We're seeking two additional members for our panel at the 2026 Media Studies Conference hosted by Poplar College. Please email jmiles@poplar.edu if interested. **Panel title:** Rethinking Documentary--Collaboration and Authorship **Panel description:** This panel explores ways to involve participants in documentary production beyond traditional observation. Historically, filmmakers have controlled the narrative, leaving little room for those on camera to shape their own stories. We'll discuss methods for working directly with participants to ensure accuracy and trust, providing strategies for scholars and practitioners interested in building stronger partnerships with the communities they document. **Academic Rationale:** Recent scholarship emphasizes participatory and community-driven practices as a response to long-standing concerns about representation and authorship. By examining strategies for collaboration, this panel contributes to debates about ethics and methodological innovation in documentary research and production. **Confirmed Participants:** Jordan Miles (Moderator), Poplar College; Taylor Chen, Summit University.

Martinsburg (April 10)

As universities trend toward eco-consciousness, more students are embracing sustainable living in campus housing. # Aristotle's Tragic Flaw Wally Bates (4:45 P.M.)
Did you guys catch what Professor Lane said about the idea of the tragic flaw in Aristotle's Poetics? I'm still a bit confused. Anita Verenne (4:47 P.M.)
Yeah, the key point was that it's not a moral weakness—it's a mistake or limitation tied to the hero's character. Wally Bates (4:48 P.M.)
I was puzzled... the flaw can be admirable yet lead to a downfall? Anita Verenne (4:50 P.M.)
Aristotle calls it hamartia—a misjudgment, not evil intent. Oedipus, for example, is tragic because his determination to uncover the truth shows courage, but it blinds him to warnings and drives him toward disaster. Dong-woo Namgung (4:51 P.M.)
Professor Lane also noted that Oedipus in Sophocles' play is arrogant and quick to anger, but these traits weren't "evil" for the ancient Greeks. Wally Bates (4:52 P.M.)
Wow, this is so different from what I learned about the tragic flaw when I studied it in high school! Dong-woo Namgung (4:53 P.M.)
Yeah, Professor Lane said it's hard for us to let go of moralizing when we read literature.

你们听懂莱恩教授讲的关于亚里士多德《诗学》中悲剧缺陷的概念了吗？ 我还是有点困惑。 Anita Verenne (4:47 P.M.)

我挺不解的……这种缺陷可能令人钦佩，却会导致毁灭？ Anita Verenne (4:50 P.M.)
亚里士多德称之为 hamartia——一种判断失误，而非恶意。 例如，俄狄浦斯是个悲剧，因为他揭露真相的决心展现了勇气，但这却使他无视警告，将他推向灾难。 Dong-woo Namgung (4:51 P.M.)
莱恩教授还提到，索福克勒斯戏剧中的俄狄浦斯傲慢且易怒，但对古希腊人来说，这些特征并不“邪恶”。 Wally Bates (4:52 P.M.)
哇，这跟我高中学习悲剧缺陷时学到的太不一样了！ Dong-woo Namgung (4:53 P.M.)

# Arts Week Flashmob

At noon yesterday, Summit View University's quad suddenly erupted into music as fifty dance majors performed a surprise choreographed routine to celebrate Arts Week.

"We wanted to bring joy and energy," said organizer Leah Ogorzelec, who spent two weeks planning the event in secret. "By all accounts, we succeeded!"

Students gathered in droves, cheering and filming the spectacle. "It made my day," said freshman Ryan Patel, who shared the video on social media. Within hours, clips of the flash mob were trending, earning thousands of likes and comments.

The performance ended with a dramatic group pose and applause echoing across campus. "It's all about making art accessible to everyone," Ms. Ogorzelec explained.

Faculty praised the creativity of the event, calling it a perfect kickoff to Arts Week. The event has sparked conversations about adding more spontaneous art experiences to campus life, proving that a little rhythm can unite an entire community.

# 艺术周快闪活动

“我们希望能带来欢乐和活力，”组织者莉亚·奥戈尔泽莱克（Leah Ogorzelec）说，她花了两个星期秘密筹划这次活动。“大家都觉得，我们成功了！”
学生们成群结队地聚集在一起，为这场表演欢呼并录像。“这让我开心了一整天，”新生瑞安·帕特尔（Ryan Patel）说，他在社交媒体上分享了这段视频。
短短几个小时内，这场快闪活动的视频片段就登上了热门趋势，获得了数以千计的点赞和评论。
表演以一个引人注目的集体造型结束，掌声在整个校园中回荡。“这一切都是为了让每个人都能接触到艺术，”奥戈尔泽莱克女士解释道。
教职员工们称赞了这次活动的创意，称其为艺术周的完美开端。
这次活动引发了关于在校园生活中增加更多自发艺术体验的讨论，证明了一点点节奏就能将整个社区团结起来。

# Kyoto Exchange Semester

Emma Lee

I can't believe I'm already halfway through my exchange semester in Japan. Time really flies when you have a busy class schedule! Last weekend, after wrapping up midterms, I finally headed out of Osaka. My destination? Kyoto.

Day 1: Temples and Shrines: I started my day at the Fushimi Inari Shrine, famous for its thousands of torii gates. It was a steep climb, but the view was absolutely worth it. Later, I visited the Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, which was stunning, with its gold-leaf-covered exterior reflecting on the tranquil pond.

Day 2: Exploring Gion Kobu, one of Kyoto's historic districts, was fascinating. I walked through the narrow streets lined with traditional wooden teahouses. The atmosphere was magical, and it seemed as if I was stepping back in time.

I'll share more about Kyoto. Stay tuned for updates!

这里的气氛很奇妙，感觉就像时光倒流了一样。

records.passage:
# CHEN'S PRODUCTION MAKES A BUZZ THAT "ECHOES" ACROSS CAMPUS

In a bold departure from typical campus productions, student director Sofia Chen staged The Enigma of Echoes, a play that blurs the line between reality and perception. The play is set in a research lab where scientists wrestle with questions about consciousness, even as their experiment begins to threaten their very sanity. The production's strength lies in its minimalist staging. Sparse lighting and carefully chosen sound effects draw the audience's focus to the performers' psychological intensity rather than to elaborate scenery. While some viewers may find the philosophical themes challenging, the play's final moments left this reviewer deeply moved and quite reflective. Standout performances included Liam Patel's portrayal of Dr. Everett, a scientist caught between self-discovery and self-doubt. The ensemble cast also conveyed the vulnerability of their roles with impressive nuance, especially for student actors, offering a layered look at human frailty.
records.translation:

学生导演索菲娅·陈大胆突破了典型的校园戏剧制作，将《回声之谜》搬上了舞台，这部剧模糊了现实与感知之间的界限。
该剧以一个研究实验室为背景，科学家们在那里苦苦思索有关意识的问题，甚至当他们的实验开始威胁到他们自身理智时也是如此。
这部作品的优势在于其极简主义的舞台布置。
稀疏的灯光和精心挑选的音效将观众的注意力吸引到了表演者强烈的心理表现上，而不是复杂的布景上。
虽然一些观众可能会觉得这些哲学主题具有挑战性，但这出戏的最后时刻让本评论员深受感动并陷入深思。
出色的表演包括利亚姆·帕特尔饰演的埃弗里特博士，一个夹在自我发现和自我怀疑之间的科学家。
全体演员也以令人印象深刻的细腻程度传达了他们角色的脆弱性，对于学生演员来说更是如此，展现了对人类脆弱性的多层次审视。

# Blackout Brings Creativity to Finals Week

A sudden power outage during finals week left Smithfield students scrambling for solutions. Students took advantage of their smart-phone flashlights, and university staff provided camping lights for dorm lounges.

"It was stressful but kind of fun," said sophomore Grace Lee. The blackout lasted six hours, caused by a transformer failure near campus. Dining services offered free coffee, and professors extended deadlines to ease the pressure.

"We made the best of it," said senior Omar Davis, who studied with his bike light. Social media buzzed with photos of candlelit study sessions, turning the inconvenience into a moment of campus unity.

Some students even organized impromptu acoustic concerts on the quad, proving that creativity thrives under constraints.

"It reminded us that community matters more than convenience," said Professor Laura Chen.

By the early morning hours, power was restored, but the evening's events left a lasting impression.

# Gym Pool Maintenance

During the week of December 28-January 3, the swimming pool at Wilson Gym will be closed for maintenance.

While the pool closes annually for a week of maintenance, this year's closure will bring a significant change: a transition from the current chlorinated sanitation system to a saltwater-based system. Saltwater systems generate chlorine naturally from dissolved salt, creating a more comfortable swimming experience. Many swimmers find the water less irritating to their skin, eyes, and hair because the chlorine levels stay more consistent. Saltwater systems also eliminate the strong chemical smell associated with manually added chlorine.

The closure is timed to occur during winter break when many students are away. However, those remaining on campus who wish to swim during that week will have access to the pool at the YWCA on Biltmore St.

To use that pool, simply show your student ID at the front desk.

# Reducing Plastic Waste

Student Housing

Four Simple Ways to Reduce Plastic Waste on Campus

Hey students!

Today, we are sharing four practical tips for reducing plastic waste in your everyday life. These small changes can make a big difference for our planet.

1. Bring Your Own Bags: Always carry reusable bags when you go shopping. Avoid single-use plastic bags that can end up in landfills and oceans.
2. Use Refillable Water Bottles: Ditch the disposable plastic bottles and invest in a durable, refillable water bottle. This reduces plastic waste AND saves you money.
3. Say No to Plastic Straws: Opt for reusable metal or bamboo straws. Many cafes and restaurants now provide eco-friendly alternatives.
4. Choose Products with Less Packaging: Look for brands that use minimal or eco-friendly packaging. This can greatly reduce the amount of waste you generate.

Share your plastic-reduction tips in the comments below!

#StudentHousing #GreenTips

# 减少塑料垃圾
学生住宿
在校园内减少塑料垃圾的四个简单方法
嘿，同学们！
今天，我们要分享四个在日常生活中减少塑料垃圾的实用技巧。
这些微小的改变可以对我们的地球产生巨大的影响。
1. 自备购物袋：去购物时总是随身携带可重复使用的环保袋。避免使用最终可能会进入垃圾填埋场和海洋的一次性塑料袋。
2. 使用可续装水瓶：丢掉一次性塑料瓶，投资购买一个耐用、可续装的水瓶。这不仅能减少塑料垃圾，还能为你省钱。
3. 拒绝塑料吸管：选择可重复使用的金属或竹制吸管。现在许多咖啡馆和餐厅都提供环保的替代品。
4. 选择包装较少的产品：寻找使用极简包装或环保包装的品牌。这可以大大减少你产生的垃圾量。

records.passage:
# Iyengar Yoga

NEXT SEMESTER, THE CAMPUS FITNESS CENTER WILL OFFER A SERIES OF RECREATIONAL CLASSES IN IYENGAR YOGA.

Iyengar yoga is distinct from other forms of yoga familiar to many people. Various forms of vinyasa—“flow yoga”—are popular today. If you have taken yoga classes, you have probably experienced this approach, which involves moving from pose to pose with minimal pauses. Iyengar yoga takes a more deliberate approach: Teachers demonstrate poses, emphasizing alignment and precision, and then instruct students with clear, specific language.

Developed by B.K.S. Iyengar (1918–2014), Iyengar Yoga is grounded in the ancient Indian tradition and philosophy of Patanjali’s Yoga-sutras. A master teacher himself, Iyengar became a highly influential teacher of teachers, creating a rigorous system of training and certification. Iyengar teachers are skilled in helping students develop strength, flexibility, and concentration. Their approach provides a safe way to learn yoga poses and accommodates students with physical limitations.

# Discover Estonia's Timeless Charm

Nestled in northern Europe, Estonia blends cultural heritage with natural beauty, making it a captivating destination.

Its crown jewel, Tallinn's medieval Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage site—invites visitors to wander cobblestone streets, admire historic buildings, and climb St. Olaf's Church for sweeping views.

Town Hall Square buzzes with markets, offering a glimpse of vibrant local life.

Just outside the capital, Lahemaa National Park showcases misty forests, tranquil bogs, and pristine coastlines. Adventurers can explore scenic trails and spot wildlife like moose and lynx.

Off the coast, Kihnu Island preserves age-old traditions, where locals wear folk attire and celebrate with music and festivals, offering an authentic cultural experience.

English is widely spoken, but learning a few Estonian phrases will enrich your journey.

With its long daylight hours and mild weather, summer is the ideal season to explore Estonia's enchanting landscapes and living history.

records.passage:
# Kintsugi Art Philosophy

Kintsugi, an ancient Japanese art, transforms broken pottery into objects of beauty by highlighting, not hiding, their cracks. Artisans use lacquer mixed with powdered gold, silver, or platinum to repair fractures, creating pieces that often become more valued than their original form.

Originating in the late fifteenth century, kintsugi reflects the philosophy of wabi-sabi, which honors imperfection and transience. Its message extends beyond ceramics, inspiring personal growth and resilience by advising people to embrace flaws as part of life's narrative. Rather than viewing damage as failure, kintsugi reframes it as transformation, symbolizing strength, authenticity, and renewal in a perfection-driven world.

Today, workshops and studios worldwide teach both its technical craft and its profound philosophy, offering learners not only artistic skills but insights into acceptance, individuality, and creative expression. Kintsugi stands as a timeless reminder that beauty lies in uniqueness and in the stories our "cracks" reveal, an idea that applies to academic life and beyond.
records.translation:
# 金缮艺术哲学
金缮是一门古老的日本艺术，它通过强调而非掩盖裂纹，将破碎的陶器转化为美丽的艺术品。
工匠们使用混合了金粉、银粉或铂金粉的漆来修复裂痕，创造出通常比原物更具价值的作品。
金缮起源于十五世纪末，体现了推崇残缺与无常的“侘寂”哲学。
它的内涵超越了陶瓷本身，通过建议人们将缺陷视为生命叙事的一部分，来激发个人的成长与韧性。
金缮没有将破损视为失败，而是将其重新定义为一种转变，在一个追求完美的世界中象征着力量、真实与重生。
如今，世界各地的工坊和工作室都在教授其技术工艺和深刻哲理，不仅为学习者提供艺术技能，还提供对接纳、个性与创造性表达的深刻见解。
金缮作为一个永恒的提醒，告诉我们美存在于独特性以及我们的“裂痕”所展现的故事中，这一理念不仅适用于学术生活，也适用于更广泛的领域。

# Nuclear Research Reactor

Yesterday, the university flipped the switch on its new nuclear research reactor in the basement of the Franklin Applied Energy Lab, turning the engineering quad into the hottest spot on campus--literally and figuratively. The reactor, about the size of a classroom, won't charge cell phones or brew coffee; it's built for neutron experiments, advanced materials research, and isotope production. "The launch of this laboratory will provide unparalleled opportunities for the university," said Dr. Evelyn Pillai, project lead. While some students have expressed safety concerns, a university spokesperson assured the community that the reactor is safer than the chemistry labs most first-year students wander into. "Radiation levels outside the facility are lower than what you'd get on a cross-country flight," said Dr. Pillai. Meanwhile, the Physics Club is planning a festive "Critical Mass Mixer" for Friday evening. The invitation features an atom whose colorful orbiting electrons are juggled by a mole.

# 核研究反应堆
昨天，学校启动了位于富兰克林应用能源实验室地下室的新核研究反应堆，这使得工程方庭在字面上和比喻意义上都成了校园里最“热”的地方。
这个大约有一间教室那么大的反应堆不会用来给手机充电或煮咖啡；它是为中子实验、先进材料研究和同位素生产而建造的。“该实验室的启用将为大学提供无与伦比的机遇，”项目负责人伊夫林·皮莱（Evelyn Pillai）博士说。
虽然一些学生表达了对安全的担忧，但大学发言人向社区保证，该反应堆比大多数大一新生常去的化学实验室还要安全。“设施外部的辐射水平比你乘坐横跨全国的航班受到的辐射还要低，”皮莱博士说。
与此同时，物理俱乐部正在筹划周五晚上的一场欢乐的“临界质量联谊会”。
邀请函上画着一个原子，一只鼹鼠正在抛接其色彩斑斓的轨道电子。

# Dorm Time Capsule

Time Capsule Unearthed During Dorm Renovation

Construction crews renovating Murdoch Hall have discovered a time capsule buried by students in the year 1896, sparking excitement across campus.

Inside were letters, photographs, and a campus map showing buildings long gone. "It's like stepping into the past," said archivist Dana Wells, who catalogued the items. Students lined up to view the capsule's contents, marveling at the artifacts. "Seeing their hopes and dreams--it's inspiring," said junior Malik Johnson.

The university will host an exhibit next month featuring the capsule's contents alongside reflections from current students, some of whom have expressed interest in contributing to a new capsule, creating a bridge between the past and the present. "It's a reminder of how much has changed--and how much hasn't," Wells added.

The discovery has sparked conversations about campus traditions and the importance of preserving history, turning a routine renovation into a moment of shared pride and curiosity.
records.translation:
# 宿舍时间胶囊
宿舍翻新期间出土时间胶囊
正在翻新默多克大楼的施工队发现了一个由学生在1896年埋藏的时间胶囊，这在整个校园引发了轰动。
里面有信件、照片，还有一张标有早已消失的建筑的校园地图。“这就像是走进了过去，”负责对这些物品进行编目的档案管理员达娜·韦尔斯说道。
学生们排队观看胶囊里的内容，对这些文物感到惊叹。“看到他们的希望和梦想——这很鼓舞人心，”大三学生马利克·约翰逊说。
这所大学下个月将举办一场展览，展出胶囊里的物品以及在校学生的感想，其中一些学生表示有兴趣为一个新的时间胶囊做贡献，从而在过去与现在之间架起一座桥梁。“这提醒了我们有多少事情发生了改变——又有多少没有变，”韦尔斯补充道。
这一发现引发了关于校园传统和保护历史重要性的讨论，将一次常规的翻新变成了一个共享自豪感和好奇心的时刻。

# Campus Bike Sharing

Harrison University recently launched a bike-sharing program to promote sustainable transportation and reduce parking congestion. Students can now rent bikes from racks located near residence halls, academic buildings, and the student center. The program offers free rentals for an hour and charges a small fee afterward, making it affordable for short trips across campus.

Each bike is equipped with a GPS tracker to ensure security and ease of locating. "This is about giving students greener options," said transportation coordinator Alex Nguyen. "We sent out a survey last semester, and students were overwhelmingly in favor of the program. They see it as making a difference environmentally."

The initiative was funded through a partnership with Benny's Cyclery, which sells the bikes at a discount and provides maintenance. Early feedback has been positive, with students praising the convenience and environmental benefits. The university plans to expand the program next semester by adding electric bikes.

# Award Winner Returns to Alma Mater

By Kevin Martin

Students were stunned when actor Daniel Rivero, famous for his award-winning role in Horizon's Edge, visited Ashburn College on Monday.

Rivero, a recent graduate of the Theater Arts program, returned to lead an impromptu drama workshop. Students crowded the theater hall, snapping selfies with the star and asking about his journey from Ashburn to Hollywood.

"I skipped lunch just to hear him," said sophomore Lily Chen. Rivero shared stories from his early auditions, including moments of rejection that taught him resilience.

"Embrace failure--it's the doorway to invention," he told students. He also praised Ashburn's faculty for fostering his love of storytelling. "It feels like I never left," he added.

The visit sparked excitement across campus, with social media flooded by photos from the workshop. For many students, it was a reminder that big dreams can start in small classrooms.

Hey, everyone! I just **wrapped up** an incredible fitness boot camp in the beautiful city of Sydney, Australia. I wanted to share some highlights and tips from the camp with you all.

* Day 1: We started with an intense cardio session at Bondi Beach. The fresh ocean air and stunning views made the workout feel energizing and refreshing.
* Day 2: Focused on strength training at a local gym. We used a variety of equipment, including dumbbells, resistance bands, and kettlebells.

# DORM STARTUP GOES VIRAL

Two computer science majors, Priya Singh and Marco Alvarez, transformed a late-night coding session into a nationwide sensation. Their app, PlanForge, designed to help students organize assignments and track deadlines, was launched from their dorm room at the end of the semester.

"We built it to survive finals," Priya laughed. Within a week, downloads skyrocketed past 10,000, and alumni investors began reaching out. The duo has been invited to present at a major tech conference.

"It's surreal," Marco said. "We never imagined this level of attention." Students are thrilled. "It's a lifesaver--I finally feel on top of my work," said sophomore Jenna Brooks.

The university's entrepreneurship center has offered mentorship to the two computer science majors. Professors have called the innovation a perfect example of student creativity.

Priya and Marco hope to expand the app's features to include group-project tools and reminders, proving big ideas can start in small dorm rooms.

# Water Service Interruption

Attention Residents!

Due to necessary maintenance on the main water line, there will be a temporary interruption in water service for all residents in the Maplewood dormitory.

Date: Monday, March 15 Time: 9:00 A.M.-4:00 P.M.

Important Information:

1. Preparation:

* Fill containers with water for drinking and cooking before the interruption.

* Store enough water for personal hygiene needs.

2. During the Interruption:

* Do not attempt to use faucets, showers, or any appliances that require water.

* Toilets may not function properly; please plan accordingly.

3. After Service Resumes:

* Run cold water through all faucets for a few minutes to clear any sediment.

* Check for any leaks and report them immediately to the maintenance department.

Contact Information: For questions or concerns, please contact the Maplewood Maintenance Department at 555-4321.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we work to improve our community's water infrastructure.
records.translation:
# 供水服务中断
居民请注意！
由于供水主管道需要进行必要的维护，Maplewood宿舍的所有居民将面临短暂的供水中断。
日期：3月15日，星期一 时间：上午9:00至下午4:00
重要信息：
1. 准备工作：
* 在供水中断前，用水容器储备好饮用和做饭所需的水。
* 储备足够的水以满足个人卫生的需求。
2. 供水中断期间：
* 请勿尝试使用水龙头、淋浴器或任何需要用水的电器。
* 马桶可能无法正常使用；请提前做好安排。
3. 恢复供水后：
* 打开所有水龙头，让冷水流几分钟，以清除任何沉淀物。
* 检查是否有漏水情况，并立即向维修部门报告。
联系信息：如有疑问或疑虑，请致电555-4321联系Maplewood维修部门。
对于给您带来的不便，我们深表歉意，并感谢您的理解，因为我们正在努力改善社区的供水基础设施。

Noam Mitchell

# Sleep Pattern Monitoring

How Well Did You Sleep?

In addition to using Health Geek to track your exercise, you can use it to monitor your sleep. Wear the wristband at night. In the morning, upload data to the phone app and get a readout. Here's a sample.

Chart: Percentage of Time in Each Sleep Stage

* Light Sleep: 50 percent
* Deep Sleep: 10 percent
* REM Sleep: 25 percent
* Awake: 15 percent

At night, your body moves naturally from one sleep stage to another. Heart rate and movement are used to calculate your sleep pattern.

Light Sleep: The muscles relax. Heart rate and breathing slow down. About half of sleeping time is usually spent in light sleep.

Deep Sleep: The body is deeply relaxed. This stage is critical for physical recovery and growth.

REM (Rapid Eye Movement) Sleep: Brain activity increases, and vivid dreams may occur. Even though the eyes are closed, they move quickly. This stage is essential for memory, learning, and creativity.

Awake: It is normal for a person to wake up several times at night.

# Sleep Stage Tracking

How Well Did You Sleep?

Health Geek is a wristband that tracks exercise and monitors sleep. Wear the wristband at night. In the morning, upload the data to the phone app.

Percentage of Time in Each Sleep Stage:

- Light Sleep: 50%
- Deep Sleep: 10%
- REM Sleep: 25%
- Awake: 15%

The body naturally moves between sleep stages during the night. The wristband uses heart rate and movement to calculate sleep patterns.

- Light sleep: Muscles relax, and heart rate and breathing slow down. About half of the night is usually spent in light sleep.
- Deep sleep: This stage is critical for physical recovery and growth.
- REM sleep: Brain activity increases, vivid dreams can occur, and the eyes move quickly. This stage is important for memory, learning, and creativity.
- Awake: It is normal to wake up several times during the night.

# Greenfield's Dining Hall

Students can't stop talking about a new pasta dish that was introduced.

# Attention Residents of Maple Heights Dormitory

Subject: Scheduled Maintenance and Upgrades

Dear Residents,

Our maintenance team will be performing essential upgrades to the building's plumbing and electrical systems. This work is necessary to ensure the continued safety and comfort of all residents. The upgrades will take place over the course of three weeks, Monday, October 2, to Friday, October 20.

Key Details:

- Work Hours: Maintenance activities will occur between 9:00 A.M. and 5:00 P.M., Monday through Friday.
- Water Interruptions: Temporary water outages may occur during this period. We will **strive** to keep interruptions to a minimum and will notify you in advance.
- Noise Levels: Expect increased noise levels due to the nature of the work being performed.
- Access to Units: Maintenance personnel may need access to individual units to complete necessary upgrades. Notices will be sent 24 hours in advance to inform you of any required access.

We appreciate your cooperation and understanding during this important maintenance period. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact the management office at 555-4321 or email us at management@mapleheights.com.

Sincerely,

Maple Heights Management

# Fitness Boot Camp

Post by Laura Kim, Fitness Coach

Hey, everyone! I just **wrapped up** an incredible fitness boot camp in the beautiful city of Sydney, Australia. I wanted to share some highlights and tips from the camp with you all.

- Day 1: We started with an intense cardio session at Bondi Beach. The fresh ocean air and stunning views made the workout feel energizing and refreshing.
- Day 2: Focused on strength training at a local gym. We used a variety of equipment, including dumbbells, resistance bands, and kettlebells.
- Day 3: Took a break from intense workouts and did a yoga session at a park overlooking the Sydney Opera House. The serene environment helped everyone relax and recharge.
- Day 4: Ended the camp with a group hike through the Blue Mountains. It was challenging but absolutely worth it for the breathtaking scenery.

Throughout the boot camp, we emphasized the importance of proper nutrition and hydration. I shared tips on how to maintain a balanced diet and stay hydrated, especially during intense physical activities. I'm already looking forward to the next boot camp! If you have any questions about the workouts or want more fitness tips, feel free to ask in the comments below!

#FitnessBootCamp #Sydney #HealthyLiving #Workout
records.translation:
# 健身训练营
发帖人：健身教练劳拉·金
大家好！
我刚刚在澳大利亚美丽的悉尼市结束了一场不可思议的健身训练营。
我想和大家分享一些这次训练营的亮点和建议。
- 第一天：我们在邦迪海滩以一场高强度的有氧运动开始。清新的海风和迷人的景色让人在锻炼时感到充满活力和神清气爽。
- 第二天：在当地一家健身房专注于力量训练。我们使用了各种器械，包括哑铃、阻力带和壶铃。
- 第三天：从高强度的锻炼中休息一下，在一个可以俯瞰悉尼歌剧院的公园里上了一堂瑜伽课。宁静的环境帮助大家放松和恢复精力。
- 第四天：以一次穿越蓝山的团队徒步结束了训练营。这很有挑战性，但为了那令人叹为观止的景色，绝对是值得的。
在整个训练营期间，我们强调了适当营养和水分补充的重要性。
我分享了如何保持均衡饮食和保持水分的技巧，尤其是在进行剧烈体育活动时。
我已经开始期待下一次健身训练营了！
如果你对这些锻炼有任何疑问，或者想要更多的健身建议，请随时在下方评论区提问！
#健身训练营 #悉尼 #健康生活 #锻炼

# SCIENCE LIBRARY RENOVATION ANNOUNCEMENT

The Woods Science Library will be temporarily closed starting Monday, August 2, for renovation. The renovation is expected to take approximately six weeks.

Important Information:

1. Book Returns:

* Please return all borrowed books to the temporary drop-off location at the community center, located at 123 Elm Street.

2. Online Services:

* Digital resources such as e-books and online databases will remain available throughout the renovation period. Visit our website at www.woodslib.edu for access.

3. Programs and Events:

* All scheduled programs and events will be relocated to the community center. Check our website for updated schedules and locations.

4. Contact Information:

* For inquiries, please contact the library staff at info@woodslib.edu or call 555-6781.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we work to expand our library facilities. We're sure patrons will enjoy using our new meeting rooms after September!

Woods Science Library Management

伍兹科学图书馆（Woods Science Library）将从8月2日（周一）起因翻新暂时关闭。
翻新工程预计将持续大约六周。

* 请将所有借阅的图书归还至位于榆树街（Elm Street）123号社区中心的临时还书点。

* 电子书和在线数据库等数字资源在整个翻新期间将继续开放。请访问我们的网站 www.woodslib.edu 进行访问。
3. 项目与活动：
* 所有原定的项目和活动将转移至社区中心。请查看我们的网站以获取更新的日程和地点。
4. 联系信息：
* 如有疑问，请通过 info@woodslib.edu 或致电 555-6781 联系图书馆工作人员。
由于我们正致力于扩建图书馆设施，对您造成的不便我们深表歉意，并感谢您的理解。

# AI-Generated Art on Campus

Visitors to the Petrunich Gallery can now view an exhibit of AI-generated paintings that blur the line between human creativity and machine learning. One standout work, Dream Algorithm, depicts a city floating in a sea of binary code, while another, Echoes of Light, uses layered brushstrokes created by artificial neural networks to mimic sunrise over glass towers.

The exhibit, which was funded by an arts innovation grant, allows visitors to interact with a program that generates custom artwork in real time, allowing them to choose themes and color palettes. This feature has become the centerpiece of the show, enchanting everyone from art majors to computer science instructors.

"We're exploring the intersection of creativity and technology," said curator Dana Fields. "It challenges what art means."

"I made a painting with code, it felt empowering," said senior art major Sofia Ramirez. "It's a new frontier."

这一特色已成为展览的核心，吸引了从艺术专业学生到计算机科学讲师的所有人。
“我们正在探索创造力与技术的交汇点，”策展人达娜·菲尔兹说。“它挑战了艺术的意义。”
“我用代码创作了一幅画，感觉充满力量，”高年级艺术专业学生索菲亚·拉米雷斯说。“这是一个新领域。”

Harrison University recently launched a bike-sharing program to promote sustainable transportation and reduce parking congestion. Students can now rent bikes from racks located near residence halls, academic buildings, and the student center. The program offers free rentals for an hour and charges a small fee afterward, making it affordable for short trips across campus.

Each bike is equipped with a GPS tracker to ensure security and ease of locating. “This is about giving students greener options,” said transportation coordinator Alex Nguyen. “We sent out a survey last semester, and students were overwhelmingly in favor of the program. They see it as making a difference environmentally.”

The initiative was funded through a partnership with Benny’s Cyclery, which sells the bikes at a discount and provides maintenance. Early feedback has been positive, with students praising the convenience and environmental benefits. The university plans to expand the program next semester by adding electric bikes.

哈里森大学最近启动了一项共享单车计划，旨在促进可持续交通并缓解停车拥堵问题。
学生们现在可以从位于宿舍楼、教学楼和学生中心附近的停车架上租用单车。
该计划提供一小时免费租赁，之后收取少量费用，这使得在校园内进行短途出行变得非常实惠。
每辆单车都配备了GPS追踪器，以确保安全并方便定位。
“这是为了给学生提供更环保的选择，”交通协调员亚历克斯·阮（Alex Nguyen）说。

**Subject:** Supporting information needed  
**Attachments:** 1 file

Dear Ms. Gupta,

Thank you for submitting your research grant application. The committee is ready to finalize our review, but a few items in the proposed budget need clarification to ensure accurate evaluation:

- For equipment, provide a brief justification and confirmation that the items are allowed under the grant's guidelines.
- For contracted services, please identify the intended vendor (or note "to be determined") and provide the basis for the cost estimate.

Please upload the revised budget via the grant portal by November 18. I have attached sample budget scenarios that you may use as examples when making your calculations. Please also verify your current enrollment by uploading a PDF of your course schedule. I'm happy to discuss any questions by phone or email. Thank you for your prompt attention.

Regards,

Michael Anderson  
Office of Sponsored Programs

它仅适用于室内应用。

items.explanation: The researchers state their goal is to "reduce costly repairs" and envision "bridges that fix themselves," which logically supports the inference that the material will lower maintenance expenses for public infrastructure.

它可以显著降低公共基础设施的维护成本。

translation.explanation: 研究人员表示，他们的目标是“减少昂贵的维修费用”，并设想了“能自我修复的桥梁”，这在逻辑上支持了该材料将降低公共基础设施维护费用的推断。

records.passage:
Researchers at the university have developed an affordable self-healing
concrete. When cracks form, embedded microcapsules release a gap-sealing
mineral solution. The prototype has already survived 50 freeze-thaw
cycles in the lab, and now real-world testing is beginning on campus
walkways, although students and faculty probably will not notice
anything unusual beneath their feet.

Researchers predict huge benefits. "Our goal is to reduce costly repairs
and extend building lifespans," said lead researcher Dr. Elena Vargas.
"Imagine bridges that fix themselves after storms." Civil engineering
professor Mark Chen called the innovation both practical and
environmentally responsible. "This could revolutionize construction," he
said. "By minimizing waste and extending the life of materials, we're
saving money and reducing the environmental footprint."

Larger trials are in the works, but for now campus walkways are a living
laboratory, offering a glimpse into a future where concrete is resilient
enough to heal itself.
records.translation:
该大学的研究人员开发出了一种价格合理的自修复混凝土。
当裂缝形成时，嵌入的微胶囊会释放出一种填补缝隙的矿物溶液。
该原型已在实验室通过了50次冻融循环，目前正在校园步道上开始实地测试，尽管学生和教职员工可能不会注意到脚下有什么异样。
研究人员预见到了巨大的益处。
首席研究员埃琳娜·巴尔加斯（Dr. Elena Vargas）博士表示：“我们的目标是减少昂贵的维修费用并延长建筑的使用寿命。”
“想象一下那些在风暴过后能自我修复的桥梁。”
土木工程教授马克·陈（Mark Chen）称这项创新既实用又环保。
“这可能会彻底改变建筑行业，”他说道。
“通过最大限度地减少浪费并延长材料寿命，我们在节省资金的同时，也在减少对环境的影响。”
更大规模的试验正在筹备中，但目前校园步道就是一个活生生的实验室，让人们得以窥见未来——在那时，混凝土将具有足够的韧性来实现自我修复。

# Global Beats: International Culture Night

**Read a flyer.**

**Join us for a celebration of music, dance, and culture from across the  
globe!**

**Global Beats: International Culture Night** brings student groups and  
campus performers together at **Hartley Auditorium** for live sets,  
pop-up dance lessons (salsa, bhangra, K-pop), a parade of flags, and a  
showcase of traditional dress.

Explore cultural booths, sample global snacks, and drop into an  
interactive drumming circle. Feel free to wear clothing that represents  
your heritage and get ready to move!

All are welcome: students, staff, families, and neighbors.

**Doors open at 7:00 P.M.** with a DJ warm-up; performances begin soon  
after. A sign-up list for community spotlight slots will be posted near  
the entrance.

**Entry is free,** and there is limited front-row seating, so plan to  
arrive early to secure a spot near the heart of the action. Celebrate  
diversity, discover new rhythms, and leave with a few new steps in your  
repertoire. Let's make the campus dance!
records.translation:
# 全球节拍：国际文化之夜
**阅读传单。**
**加入我们，参加这场汇集全球音乐、舞蹈和文化的盛典！**
**“全球节拍：国际文化之夜”**将学生团体和校园表演者汇聚在**哈特利礼堂 (Hartley Auditorium)**，带来现场表演、即兴舞蹈课程（萨尔萨、邦拉、韩流流行舞）、国旗巡游以及传统服饰展示。
探索文化展位，品尝全球小吃，并加入互动鼓乐圈。
欢迎穿着代表您文化遗产的服饰，准备好随之律动！
欢迎所有人参加：学生、教职员工、家属和邻居。
**晚上 7:00 开门**，届时会有 DJ 热场；表演随后不久开始。
入口处将张贴社区焦点环节的报名表。
**入场免费，** 且前排座位有限，因此请计划尽早到达，以确保在活动中心区域占得一席之地。
庆祝多样性，发现新节奏，在离开时学到几步新舞步。
让我们在校园里舞动起来！

records.passage:
Baker University Women's Rugby Championship
The Baker University women's rugby team will play in the national championship for the first time in 25 years.
The team secured its spot last week with a decisive 32–12 victory over Ridgefield College. Head coach Sara Okoye, a former national champion herself, led the team through months of intensive training. Key players including emerging talent Alejandra Ortiz and veteran team members contributed to the win.
The championship match is on November 11 at Springfield Stadium. The university is offering free shuttle transportation to the game, and students can attend by presenting their ID cards.
Campus enthusiasm is growing in anticipation of the event. A pep rally scheduled for November 9 will give fans an opportunity to meet the players and receive complimentary gear.
Team captain Maria Patel stated, "This is our biggest achievement in a quarter century. We are playing for the entire Baker community and everyone who has supported us."
records.translation:
贝克大学女子橄榄球锦标赛
贝克大学女子橄榄球队将在 25 年来首次参加全国锦标赛。
该队上周以 32-12 的比分决定性地战胜了里奇菲尔德学院，锁定了席位。
主教练萨拉·奥科耶本人曾获得过全国冠军，她带领球队进行了数月的强化训练。
包括新秀亚历杭德拉·奥尔蒂斯和资深队员在内的关键球员为此次胜利做出了贡献。
锦标赛将于 11 月 11 日在斯普林菲尔德体育场举行。
大学将提供前往比赛现场的免费班车，学生凭学生证即可参加。
人们对这一活动的期待日益高涨，校园热情持续升温。
定于 11 月 9 日举行的赛前动员大会将让球迷有机会见到球员并领取免费装备。

records.passage:
# Social Networks and Influence

In today's digital age, social networks play a significant role in
shaping opinions and behaviors. The influence of these networks is not
merely about the number of connections one might have, but about the
quality and nature of those interactions. Sociologists have long been
interested in how individuals within a network can influence the group's
overall dynamics. This concept is sometimes referred to as social
capital.

**[A]** The structure of a network can determine the flow of information.
**[B]** An individual positioned at the intersection of various groups,
known as a bridge, often plays a crucial role in disseminating
information. **[C]** This person can introduce new ideas and perspectives
to different parts of the network, thereby influencing opinions and
possibly altering behaviors. **[D]** Another factor is homophily, where
individuals are more likely to form connections with others who are
similar to themselves in terms of opinions, values, or social status.
While homophily can reinforce existing beliefs, it can also create echo
chambers, limiting exposure to diverse perspectives. The presence of
influential individuals, often termed opinion leaders, can amplify or
mitigate the effects of network structures by means of their social
skills or charisma. Sociologists aim to uncover the **nuanced** ways social
networks shape collective behavior.
records.translation:
# 社会网络与影响力
在当今的数字时代，社会网络在塑造观点和行为方面发挥着重要作用。
这些网络的影响力不仅仅在于一个人可能拥有的连接数量，而在于这些互动的质量和性质。
社会学家长期以来一直对网络中的个体如何影响群体的整体动态感兴趣。
这一概念有时被称为社会资本。
**[A]** 网络的结构可以决定信息的流动。
**[B]** 处于不同群体交汇点的个体被称为“桥梁”，通常在信息传播中起着至关重要的作用。
**[C]** 这个人可以将新的想法和观点引入网络的不同部分，从而影响观点并可能改变行为。
**[D]** 另一个因素是同质性，即个体更有可能与在观点、价值观或社会地位方面与自己相似的人建立联系。
虽然同质性可以强化现有的信念，但它也会产生“回声室”效应，限制对多样化观点的接触。
有影响力的个体（通常被称为意见领袖）的存在，可以通过他们的社交技巧或魅力来放大或减轻网络结构的影响。
社会学家旨在揭示社会网络塑造集体行为的**细微**方式。

# Quantum Dots

Quantum dots are tiny semiconductor particles with unique optical
properties, making them valuable in display technology. When exposed to
light, these nanoparticles emit bright, pure colors that can be finely
tuned by varying their size. This allows for more vibrant and accurate
colors in screens, surpassing traditional display technologies. Their
application in displays has revolutionized the consumer electronics
industry. For example, quantum dot-enhanced televisions offer a broader
color spectrum and energy conservation compared to conventional
light-emitting diode (LED) displays because they require less
backlighting.

Environmental benefits are another advantage. Traditional displays often
use harmful heavy metals like cadmium and lead. Quantum dots can be made
from less toxic materials, and researchers are working on cadmium-free
quantum dots to further reduce environmental impact.

The manufacture of quantum dots requires extreme precision. As a result,
challenges remain in scaling up production. However, this is a
worthwhile endeavor because quantum dots potentially have many
applications outside of electronics, such as in biological research.
Their small size and bright emission are ideal for tagging and tracking
molecules in living organisms. This allows for long-term observation of
dynamic biological processes.

# Space Debris: A Growing Concern

The Kessler Syndrome, proposed by NASA scientist Donald J. Kessler in
1978, hypothesizes a cascading effect in low Earth orbit (LEO) in which
collisions between satellites and debris---defunct satellites, spent
rocket stages, and fragments from earlier collisions---generate more
fragments, exponentially increasing the likelihood of further
collisions. This feedback loop could render certain orbital regions
unusable for decades. While the model is compelling, some assumptions
merit scrutiny. For instance, it presumes a uniform distribution of
debris and constant collision probability, yet orbital mechanics suggest
that debris clusters in specific altitudes and orbital paths,
potentially limiting the scope of cascading events.

Moreover, technological advancements in debris tracking and active
removal may mitigate the risk more effectively than Kessler originally
envisioned. Critics argue that the syndrome underestimates the
**resilience** of orbital infrastructure and overstates the inevitability of
runaway collisions. Alternative explanations for observed debris growth
include a greater number of satellite launches and fragmentation from
aging spacecraft, rather than a self-sustaining cascade.

Nonetheless, the Kessler Syndrome remains a valuable heuristic for space
policy, emphasizing the need for international cooperation and
sustainable orbital practices. Its cautionary implications are
profound---especially as commercial constellations dramatically increase
the number of active satellites in LEO.
records.translation:
# 太空碎片：日益严重的隐忧
凯斯勒现象（The Kessler Syndrome）由美国国家航空航天局（NASA）科学家唐纳德·J·凯斯勒于 1978 年提出，该理论假设在近地轨道（LEO）中存在一种级联效应，即卫星与碎片（废弃卫星、废弃火箭级以及早期碰撞产生的碎片）之间的碰撞会产生更多碎片，从而成倍增加进一步发生碰撞的可能性。
这种反馈循环可能导致某些轨道区域在数十年内无法使用。
虽然该模型具有说服力，但某些假设仍值得推敲。
例如，它假定碎片是均匀分布的且碰撞概率恒定，然而轨道力学表明，碎片聚集在特定的高度和轨道路径中，这可能会限制级联事件的范围。
此外，碎片追踪和主动清理方面的技术进步可能会比凯斯勒最初设想的更有效地降低风险。
批评者认为，该现象低估了轨道基础设施的**韧性**，并夸大了失控碰撞的必然性。
对于观察到的碎片增长，其他解释包括卫星发射数量的增加以及老化航天器的解体，而不是自发持续的级联反应。
尽管如此，凯斯勒现象仍然是空间政策的一项有价值的启发式工具，强调了国际合作和可持续轨道实践的必要性。
它的警示意义深远——特别是随着商业星座大幅增加近地轨道上的活跃卫星数量。

# Dinosaur Feathers

Paleontologists once thought dinosaurs were completely covered in
scales. Recent discoveries have overturned this idea. Fossils found in
China reveal some dinosaurs had feathers. These fossils, dating back
approximately 126 million years, show **traces** of feathers around
skeletons. The feathers were not for flight but likely for insulation or
display.

One significant find was the feathered dinosaur Sinosauropteryx. This
small, meat-eating dinosaur had simple, hairlike feathers on its body.
This discovery showed that feathers were more common among dinosaurs
than previously thought. Another discovery involved the larger, more
complex feathers of Caudipteryx. These feathers were similar to those of
modern birds, suggesting that feathers evolved in stages, becoming more
sophisticated over time.

**[A]** Researchers are now studying how feathered dinosaurs might have
used their plumage. **[B]** Some theories suggest that feathers helped
regulate body temperature, while other theories propose that feathers
were used for mating displays or camouflage. **[C]** Understanding feather
function in dinosaurs provides insights into their behavior and
evolution. **[D]**

The idea that birds are direct descendants of dinosaurs has gained
support from the findings about feathers. Fossil evidence reveals that
many theropod dinosaurs, such as Velociraptor, had feathers similar to
those of modern birds. These similarities in feather structures,
including quill knobs and complex branching patterns, strengthen the
theory that birds evolved from theropod dinosaurs.
records.translation:
# 恐龙羽毛
古生物学家曾认为恐龙全身都覆盖着鳞片。
最近的发现推翻了这一观点。
在中国发现的化石揭示了一些恐龙拥有羽毛。
这些可以追溯到大约1.26亿年前的化石，在骨骼周围显示出了羽毛的**痕迹**。
这些羽毛不是为了飞行，而很可能是为了保温或展示。
一个重要的发现是羽毛恐龙——中华龙鸟。
这种体型较小的食肉恐龙身上长有简单的毛发状羽毛。
这一发现表明，恐龙拥有羽毛的现象比以前认为的更为普遍。
另一项发现涉及尾羽龙更大、更复杂的羽毛。
这些羽毛与现代鸟类的羽毛相似，表明羽毛是分阶段进化的，随着时间的推移变得越来越复杂。
**[A]** 研究人员现在正在研究有羽毛的恐龙是如何使用它们的羽毛的。
**[B]** 一些理论认为羽毛有助于调节体温，而其他理论则提出羽毛被用于求偶展示或伪装。
**[C]** 了解恐龙羽毛的功能可以深入洞察它们的行为和进化。
**[D]**
鸟类是恐龙直接后裔的观点得到了有关羽毛发现的支持。
化石证据显示，许多兽脚类恐龙（如伶盗龙）拥有与现代鸟类相似的羽毛。
羽毛结构上的这些相似性，包括羽茎瘤和复杂的的分支模式，加强了鸟类由兽脚类恐龙进化而来的理论。

records.passage:
# Diane Arbus

Diane Arbus (1923–1971) occupies a singular place in the history of photography, celebrated and criticized for her **stark**, intimate portraits of a wide range of people, including some of unconventional appearance or marginalized social status. Her work has long provoked debate because it resists easy moral or aesthetic categorization. Some critics, such as Susan Sontag, argued that Arbus' photographs create a troubling distance between viewer and subject. Sontag claimed that Arbus' images risk turning people into spectacles of oddity, suggesting that her gaze could be predatory in its fascination with difference. Others, however, see Arbus as a profoundly empathetic artist. Writers like Arthur Lubow emphasize her ability to reveal her subjects' complexity and dignity, noting that many of them collaborated willingly and even joyfully in the creation of their portraits.

A further line of debate surrounds Arbus' style: her use of frontal composition, square format, and direct flash has been interpreted negatively—as a cold, clinical approach—and positively—as a method that strips away artifice to expose deeper truths. Ultimately, Arbus' work continues to inspire disagreement because it challenges viewers to confront their own assumptions about normalcy, beauty, and vulnerability. Her photographs remain powerful precisely because they refuse to resolve these tensions.
records.translation:
# 黛安·阿勃丝
黛安·阿勃丝（Diane Arbus，1923-1971）在摄影史上占有独特的地位，她因对各种各样的人——包括一些外表非常规或社会地位边缘的人——拍摄的**冷峻**且亲密的肖像而受到赞誉和批评。
她的作品长期以来引发争议，因为它拒绝简单的道德或审美分类。
一些批评家，如苏珊·桑塔格（Susan Sontag），认为阿勃丝的照片在观察者和被摄对象之间建立了一种令人不安的距离。
桑塔格声称，阿勃丝的影像冒着将人变成猎奇奇观的风险，暗示她的目光因对差异的痴迷而带有掠夺性。
然而，其他人则认为阿勃丝是一位具有深厚同理心的艺术家。
像亚瑟·卢博（Arthur Lubow）这样的作家强调她揭示受访者复杂性和尊严的能力，指出他们中的许多人都是心甘情愿、甚至愉快地参与了肖像的创作。
进一步的争论围绕着阿勃丝的风格展开：她对正面构图、正方形画幅和直接闪光灯的使用被解读为负面的——一种冷漠、临床的方法——也被解读为正面的——一种剥离虚饰以揭示深层真相的方法。
归根结底，阿勃丝的作品之所以持续引发分歧，是因为它挑战了观众去面对自己关于常态、美丽和脆弱的假设。
她的照片之所以保持着强大的力量，恰恰是因为它们拒绝化解这些张力。

records.passage:
# Digital Media's Influence on Writing

Digital media's rise has transformed writing styles, creating new genres and challenges. Unlike traditional print media, digital platforms enable instantaneous sharing, forcing writers to adapt their craft. **[A]** Blogs, tweets, and other forms prioritize brevity. **[B]**

A **pivotal** change is the heightened focus on audience interactivity. **[C]** Writers must now be mindful of how their work is received and discussed online, adjusting their style in response to audience feedback. **[D]** This can lead to more dynamic writing but requires constant shifts in tone and content. Interaction between writers and readers thus becomes a crucial element of modern writing.

Digital media also influences language evolution, introducing abbreviations, slang, and emojis as communication tools. Writers face the challenge of balancing informal language with clarity and professionalism. This language shift enriches writing but raises concerns about preserving linguistic standards.

Along with all the disruptions, digital media also offers avenues for innovation. Writers can seamlessly integrate multimedia elements, crafting immersive narratives that go beyond text. However, this integration calls for careful evaluation of how these elements impact the core message, which can sometimes be overshadowed by the allure of visual and auditory effects.

# Traffic Psychology

Traffic psychology explores how individual differences and social contexts shape driving behavior, often in counterintuitive ways. [A] While traits like impulsivity are frequently linked to risky driving, research shows that this connection is not always straightforward. [B] For instance, impulsive individuals may drive cautiously in familiar environments but exhibit recklessness when faced with novel or stressful situations. [C] Moreover, environmental cues - such as heavy traffic or aggressive drivers - can amplify underlying character traits. [D]

Social influences further complicate the picture. Young drivers, for example, may engage in riskier maneuvers when accompanied by peers, driven by a desire to impress or conform. However, this effect is not universal. The presence of a **vigilant** passenger - such as a parent or responsible friend - can counteract impulsive tendencies and promote safer driving. This raises questions about how social roles and expectations modulate behavior.

Some researchers argue that focusing too heavily on personality overlooks structural factors like road design or traffic law enforcement, which may exert a stronger influence on safety outcomes. Yet, understanding the psychological underpinnings of driving remains crucial for designing effective interventions. By integrating insights from personality psychology, social dynamics, and environmental design, traffic psychology offers a nuanced framework for improving road safety.

# 交通心理学
交通心理学探讨了个体差异和社会背景如何塑造驾驶行为，且其方式往往是违反直觉的。 [A]
虽然冲动等特质经常与危险驾驶联系在一起，但研究表明，这种联系并不总是直接的。 [B]
例如，冲动型个体在熟悉的环境中可能驾驶得很谨慎，但在面对新奇或压力较大的情况时却会表现出鲁莽。 [C]
此外，环境线索——如拥挤的交通或具有侵略性的驾驶者——可以放大潜在的性格特质。 [D]
社会影响使情况进一步复杂化。
例如，年轻驾驶员在同龄人陪伴时，出于给人留下深刻印象或从众的欲望，可能会进行更危险的操作。
然而，这种效应并非普遍存在。
一名**警觉的**乘客——如父母或负责任的朋友——的存在可以抵消冲动倾向并促进更安全的驾驶。
这引发了关于社会角色和期望如何调节行为的问题。
一些研究人员认为，过于关注人格会忽略道路设计或交通执法等结构性因素，而这些因素可能对安全结果产生更强的影响。
然而，了解驾驶的心理基础对于设计有效的干预措施仍然至关重要。
通过整合来自人格心理学、社会动力学和环境设计的见解，交通心理学为改善道路安全提供了一个细致入微的框架。

records.passage:
# The Getty Kouros

In 1985, the J. Paul Getty Museum acquired what it believed to be a Greek kouros (a statue of a naked youth) dating from the Archaic period (650–480 B.C.E.), estimating the date of origin as approximately 530 B.C.E. The Getty Kouros's authenticity soon came into question, however. Supporters cited scientific analyses suggesting that the statue's marble is consistent with marble known to have come from ancient Greek quarries and that its surface shows chemical changes consistent with long-term burial. Some scholars also argue that peculiar inconsistencies in the statue's style—it incorporates features from different regions and periods—could reflect a transitional moment in Greek sculpture.

Skeptics contend that these inconsistencies undermine the case for authenticity. The Kouros combines traits from several other known sixth-century B.C.E. kouroi in a way that appears too eclectic to be genuine. To these observers, the statue looks like a modern forger's creation—a confused imitation of Greek Archaic elements rather than the genuine product of a coherent sculptural tradition. Furthermore, scientists recognize that modern forgers can artificially age marble.

Because neither scientific analysis nor stylistic evaluation yields decisive results, the question of the Kouros's authenticity remains unresolved.

# 盖蒂青年雕像
1985年，J·保罗·盖蒂博物馆获得了一尊他们认为是古风时期（公元前650-480年）的希腊青年雕像（kouros，指裸体青年雕像），估计其起源日期约为公元前530年。
然而，盖蒂青年雕像的真实性很快就受到了质疑。
支持者引用科学分析指出，该雕像的大理石与已知来自古希腊采石场的大理石一致，且其表面显示的化学变化与长期埋藏的情况相符。
一些学者还认为，雕像风格中奇特的不一致性——它融合了来自不同地区和时期的特征——可能反映了希腊雕塑的一个过渡时期。
怀疑者则主张，这些不一致性削弱了其真实性的证据。
这尊青年雕像结合了其他几尊已知的公元前六世纪青年雕像的特征，其方式显得过于折衷，不像真品。

records.passage:
# The Question of Animal Cultures

Can animals be said to possess culture? Many scientists argue that certain species do exhibit cultural traits, defining culture broadly as behaviors learned socially and transmitted across generations. Classic examples include chimpanzees using tools in ways distinctive to their local community, or whales developing group-specific songs that evolve over time. These patterns suggest that at least some animals maintain traditions not rooted solely in genetics or instinct.

Others argue that applying the term "culture" to animals risks stretching the concept beyond usefulness. Human cultures involve symbolic meaning and cumulative innovation—the ability to build on previous discoveries so that knowledge and practices become more sophisticated over generations. Nonhuman species have not convincingly demonstrated these abilities. Animal behaviors that appear cultural may instead reflect adaptation to environmental pressures or simple imitation, not deeper shared understandings.

A middle position acknowledges that while animals may not possess culture in the sense humans do, they can still display **rudimentary** cultural phenomena. This view emphasizes a continuum rather than a strict divide, suggesting that cultural capacities evolved gradually and appear in varying degrees across species.

Ultimately, whether animals have culture depends on how culture is defined, but growing evidence of socially transmitted behaviors challenges long-held assumptions about the uniqueness of human societies.
records.translation:
# 动物文化的问题
能说动物拥有文化吗？
许多科学家认为某些物种确实表现出文化特征，将文化广义地定义为通过社会学习并在代际间传递的行为。
典型的例子包括黑猩猩以其当地群体特有的方式使用工具，或者鲸鱼开发出随时间演变的群体特有鸣声。
这些模式表明，至少有一些动物保持着并非完全根植于遗传或本能的传统。
其他人则认为，将“文化”一词应用于动物可能会使这一概念过度延伸而失去效用。
人类文化涉及符号意义和累积创新——即在先前的发现基础上进行构建，使知识和实践在代际传递中变得更加复杂精细的能力。
非人类物种尚未令人信服地证明具备这些能力。
看起来具有文化性的动物行为可能反映的是对环境压力的适应或简单的模仿，而非更深层次的共有理解。
一种中间立场承认，虽然动物可能不具备人类意义上的文化，但它们仍能表现出**初步的**（rudimentary）文化现象。
这种观点强调的是一种连续性而非严格的划分，表明文化能力是逐渐演化的，并在不同物种中以不同程度呈现。
最终，动物是否拥有文化取决于文化如何定义，但越来越多的社会传递行为证据挑战了关于人类社会唯一性的长期假设。

records.passage:
# Evolutionary Trends in Graphic Design

Graphic design has transformed repeatedly throughout history, influenced
by both cultural shifts and technological advancements. In Europe,
during the Middle Ages (the fifth to fifteenth centuries), the creation
of intricate manuscripts was predominant. The advent of the printing
press in the fifteenth century altered these dynamics, facilitating mass
production and broadening public access to designed materials. Such
technological shifts not only changed the way art was produced but also
how it was perceived.

By the mid-twentieth century, Swiss design emerged as a response to the
chaotic visual landscape, introducing principles of minimalism and
functionality. Heavily influenced by the Bauhaus movement,
designers like Josef Müller-Brockmann **advocated for** simplicity and
rationality. Their grid-based approach brought order and
readability to what often seemed to be overwhelming visuals. Some
critics argue that the rigid structure, while effective, limited
expressive possibilities and emotional resonance in design.

Today, graphic design stands at the intersection of tradition and
innovation. While digital tools democratize access and encourage
experimentation, designers grapple with preserving artistic integrity.
The challenge lies in blending the precision of technology with the
warmth of human creativity. Thus, graphic design continues to evolve,
reflecting broader cultural debates about art and technology.
records.translation:
# 平面设计的演变趋势
平面设计在整个历史上经历了反复的变革，受到文化变迁和技术进步的共同影响。
在中世纪的欧洲（五世纪至十五世纪），复杂精美的手抄本创作占据主导地位。
十五世纪印刷机的出现改变了这一动态，促进了批量生产并扩大了公众接触设计材料的机会。
这种技术转变不仅改变了艺术的生产方式，也改变了人们对艺术的感知方式。
到二十世纪中叶，瑞士设计作为对混乱视觉景观的回应而出现，引入了极简主义和功能性的原则。
受包豪斯运动的深远影响，像约瑟夫·米勒-布罗克曼（Josef Müller-Brockmann）这样的设计师**倡导**简洁与理性。
他们基于网格的方法为那些通常看起来令人应接不暇的视觉效果带来了秩序和可读性。
一些批评家认为，这种僵化的结构虽然有效，但限制了设计中的表达可能性和情感共鸣。
今天，平面设计正处于传统与创新的交汇点。
虽然数字工具使获取变得大众化并鼓励实验，但设计师们仍在努力维护艺术的完整性。
挑战在于如何将技术的精确性与人类创造力的温度融合在一起。
因此，平面设计继续演变，反映了关于艺术与技术之间更广泛的文化辩论。

records.passage:
# Demographic Dynamics

The demographic transition model (DTM) illustrates the shifting patterns of birth and death rates as societies evolve from agrarian to industrialized economies. Initially, both rates are high, resulting in slow population growth due to limited access to healthcare and sanitation. As countries develop, death rates decline sharply with advances in medical care and improved living conditions. Yet, birth rates often remain high, spurring rapid population growth that can strain resources. This transition highlights the tension between demographic momentum and societal capability to meet the growing needs.

[A] A further decline in birth rates eventually occurs, influenced by greater access to education and changes in cultural norms. Families begin to view fewer children as advantageous, aligning with shifts toward economic and personal **aspirations**. [B] However, this stage brings its own challenges, including the potential for an aging population and workforce shortages. [C]

Some demographers postulate a fifth stage, characterized by persistently low birth rates that might lead to population contraction. The implications of this are complex, ranging from economic innovation driven by necessity to increased strain on social institutions and intergenerational support systems. [D] Understanding these transitions enables societies to better plan for future demographic realities, though the dynamic interplay of these factors is still unfolding.

records.passage:
# Gamma-Ray Astronomy: Unveiling the Universe

Gamma-ray astronomy has transformed our view of the cosmos by enabling scientists to detect some of the universe's most energetic and extreme phenomena, including gamma-ray bursts (GRBs). GRBs have drawn intense interest due to their mysterious origins and immense energy output. Unlike visible light, gamma rays do not penetrate Earth's atmosphere. As a result, astronomers deploy space telescopes to capture signals from cosmic events like supernovae and neutron star collisions.

The launch of the Compton Gamma Ray Observatory in 1991 provided the first comprehensive map of the gamma-ray sky, similar to the way optical telescopes map the visible sky. This breakthrough allowed scientists to pinpoint the locations of GRBs and study their properties in detail. Scientists learned that these bursts occur randomly across the sky and are not **confined to** our galaxy alone.

Despite the advances, many questions remain. Some hypothesize that GRBs are the result of merging neutron stars, while others suggest they stem from hypernovae, explosive events that dwarf typical supernovae. Each explanation carries implications for our understanding of stellar evolution and cosmic history. New telescopes like the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope may help astronomers uncover more secrets of these cosmic beacons.
records.translation:
# 伽马射线天文学：揭开宇宙的面纱
伽马射线天文学通过使科学家能够探测到宇宙中一些能量最高和最极端的现象，包括伽马射线暴（GRBs），从而改变了我们的宇宙观。
伽马射线暴因其神秘的起源和巨大的能量输出而引起了浓厚的兴趣。
与可见光不同，伽马射线不能穿透地球大气层。
因此，天文学家部署太空望远镜来捕捉来自超新星和中子星碰撞等宇宙事件的信号。
1991年康普顿伽马射线天文台的发射提供了第一幅全面的伽马射线天空图，类似于光学望远镜绘制可见天空图的方式。
这一突破使科学家能够精确锁定伽马射线暴的位置并详细研究它们的属性。
科学家们了解到，这些爆发在天空中随机发生，并不**局限于**我们银河系内部。
尽管取得了进步，但仍有许多问题尚待解决。
一些人假设伽马射线暴是中子星合并的结果，而另一些人则认为它们源于极超新星，即规模远超典型超新星的爆炸事件。
每一种解释都对我们理解恒星演化和宇宙历史具有重要意义。
像费米伽马射线太空望远镜这样的新型望远镜可能有助于天文学家揭开这些宇宙信标的更多秘密。
